description: Versioned evidence catalogue, not runtime configuration. validated is scoped to the listed verification, not population accuracy. Code status governs emission; token/element status describes product evidence. Retired legacy UA literals can remain compatible with an active output code when retirementReason explicitly records this. Unknown version ranges must stay explicit.

signals.check: navigator.webdriver === true.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: Human developers may drive or inspect an instrumented browser.

signals.check: Boundary-matched HeadlessChrome in main UA, /HeadlessChrome/i in synchronous UA-CH brand, or boundary-matched worker UA at final when worker: true.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: A human can use a headless/instrumented browser or spoof the token.

signals.check: Boundary-matched PhantomJS, Chrome-Lighthouse, Lighthouse, GTmetrix or Google-PageRenderer; PTST requires / followed by a digit.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: UA spoofing or human-requested audits; not evidence of AI or intent.

signals.check: Own callable data properties only: window callPhantom, _phantom, __nightmare, domAutomation, domAutomationController, or ^cdc_[A-Za-z0-9]+_(Array|Promise|Symbol|Object|Proxy|JSON|Window)$; document __{selenium,webdriver,driver,fxdriver}_{evaluate,unwrapped}, __webdriver_script_{fn,func,function}, __$webdriverAsyncExecutor, or $cdc_/$wdc_ prefixes. shapeValue excludes DOM/host/window values and getters.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: Page-authored functions can imitate these names; human test instrumentation can expose them.

signals.check: Own callable data properties at __playwright__binding__, __playwright__binding__controller__, __pwInitScripts, initial and final; same shape guard as GL. Arrays, plain data, getters and host objects do not count.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: Page functions may collide; feature/execution-world dependent, and a plain init-script array does not qualify.

signals.check: Case-insensitive literal configured agentTokens with boundaries excluding adjacent A-Z, a-z, digits, underscore and hyphen. Overrides replace defaults, capped at 64 tokens of 1..128 characters.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: Any page/browser can spoof its UA; fetchers without JavaScript do not run the detector.

signals.check: Exact registered element IDs at their registered direct parent in the light DOM, at start and through the bounded root/body MutationObserver until match or pagehide. No shadow roots or frames.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: Page code can plant IDs; marker UI presence is an unverified declaration, not authenticated operator identity.

signals.check: Sanitised sessionStorage lastClass.value automated with direct === true, consumed at start; one following document only. No direct provenance from CA alone.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: A person taking over the next document can inherit automation; same-origin code can plant storage.

signals.check: Sanitised lastClass.value declared_agent with direct === true; carries one document and a whitelisted stored operator, never becomes automated.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: Human manual takeover can inherit a declaration; same-origin storage is spoofable.

signals.check: Sanitised lastClass.value suspicious with direct === true from current-page evidence; consumed to a passive string before applying, only after a successful storage write. Carries suspicious for one following document only; CS alone never renews it, adds score/families or upgrades to automated/declared_agent.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; not a field accuracy result.

falsePositives: A human taking over the next page can inherit uncertain evidence; same-origin storage is spoofable.

signals.check: Both dimensions zero in any of screen, inner viewport or outer window; top-level, not hidden and focused; initial and final.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: Browser lifecycle, unusual windowing and privacy settings may expose zero dimensions.

signals.check: Screen 800x600, or screen 1280x720 equal to inner viewport on both axes.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: Real displays, VMs and responsive/test windows can have these dimensions.

signals.check: Visible focused non-mobile non-embedded top-level window: positive inner size equals outer and screen on both axes; available screen equals screen; fullscreenElement === null; matchMedia fullscreen and standalone both false. Rechecked final.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: Kiosk/PWA/F11 or unusual window managers can still share geometry; benign evidence requiring corroboration.

signals.check: Missing or empty navigator.languages AND falsy language, userLanguage, browserLanguage and systemLanguage.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: Privacy settings, old browsers and embedded environments may omit language information.

signals.check: Desktop Chrome/ UA excluding mobile/touch iPad and known embedded UAs; Chromium brands or window.chrome, existing empty plugins, pdfViewerEnabled !== false.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: PDF policies, privacy extensions and unrecognised embedded browsers may have empty plugins.

signals.check: webgl: true only: both webgl/experimental-webgl contexts unavailable, or debug renderer matches bounded SwiftShader/llvmpipe/softpipe or exact Mesa OffScreen. Missing debug extension and thrown/blocked APIs are unknown. Context released.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: Software rendering, disabled acceleration, old devices, VMs and privacy settings are normal.

signals.check: Desktop Chrome/ UA excluding mobile/embedded and Chromium-compatible synchronous brands, but no window.chrome.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: Privacy tools and browser variants can omit chrome; UA alone is insufficient.

signals.check: Falsy navigator.hardwareConcurrency; records debug code only, with no score.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: Old, embedded and privacy-focused browsers can omit the value; no positive score.

signals.check: Secure top-level Chromium, Notification.permission denied and successful notifications Permissions query returning prompt before final. No permission request; rejection/unsupported is unknown.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: User/policy permissions, privacy tools or API differences may cause mismatches.

signals.check: Input can be observed; no accepted activity after full idleMs of visible exposure (default 8000ms). Trusted or missing-isTrusted input except pointercancel counts as activity. Final only.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: Quiet reading, media watching and assistive input can produce no accepted input.

signals.check: Bounded rounded session timestamps contain fastNavCount documents (default 3), connected by positive consecutive gaps below fastNavMs (default 2000ms); reload/back_forward excluded, writable storage required. Final only.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: People can follow short links rapidly; timestamps do not establish distinct URLs.

signals.check: Untrusted mousemove, pointerdown or touchstart observed with no accepted trusted or missing-isTrusted activity. Final only; shares interaction cap 2 with NI.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: Ordinary application frameworks dispatch synthetic input.

signals.check: Trusted mousemove delta >200px or >200px from prior distinct position within 600ms; suppress a stream of >=3 positions with gaps <=120ms. Trusted mouse click detail >0 within 600ms of jump and trusted mouse pointerdown, within 2px of endpoint, >40px from previous click. Touch/pen/key/cancel clears pointer origin. Final only.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: Accessibility warp-on-click tools and rapid human cursor moves can match; no population validation.

signals.check: Final remaining sanitised tpPages >=2 after eligible decay on accepted activity without current TP. TP increments at most once per document; stale writes guarded, cap 255. Shares pointer cap 3 with TP. No initial class override.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: Repeated assistive cursor warps or human jumps can accumulate history; reloads can count again.

signals.check: worker: true: supported nonempty UA, boolean webdriver, nonempty languages joined with |, or positive hardwareConcurrency differs between main and dedicated worker; reply before final. Missing/blocked fields unknown.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

verification.versions: 2026-11-19 field runs; browser build not recorded
verification.result: Main en-US versus worker en-US,en observed; not unique to this product.

falsePositives: Locale-switching extensions can reproduce the ChatGPT field language mismatch; differences are not identity.

signals.check: worker: true: main has a nonempty UA-CH brand string, worker exposes userAgentData but null/undefined value or empty brands array. Absent API, malformed shapes, denied getter or failed worker unknown. Final directly suspicious without normal gate; never hard provenance.

verification.result: Implemented condition and synthetic contract semantics only; upstream product/browser version range not established.

falsePositives: Human Chrome DevTools device emulation and CDP UA overrides can produce this mismatch.

signals.check: Desktop Chromium only: visible direct body DIV, zero attributes and light children, closed or absent shadow root, computed display contents on insertion and after at least 250 ms. Reject if another populated/attributed body DIV computes to contents. Operator anthropic; claim dom_host carried with CD. Observed evidence, not verified identity.

verification.versions: 1.0.107; Chrome 158 on macOS; one owner-run profile with about 46 extensions
verification.result: Host: 4/4 controlled runs vs 0/2 controls. Burst: 3/3 typing runs. Untrusted select change: 2/2 select runs. Extension assets/agent-visual-indicator.js read locally 2026-11-22; no broader release coverage established.

falsePositives: Closed-shadow widgets with :host display:contents and persistent empty portals under selective page CSS may match. Open roots, transient containers and broad page CSS are excluded. Monitor dom_host separately in GA4; observed host evidence does not prove each action is automated.

signals.check: At least 3 trusted non-composing insertText events on the same control within 5 ms with positive elapsed time. Uses event creation timestamps, falling back to performance.now() or Date.now(). Final only; interaction cap 2.

falsePositives: Assistive technology, voice input, text expanders and hardware scanners can batch insertText. Identical quantized timestamps are ignored. No text or values are read.

signals.check: Explicitly untrusted change on enabled, writable SELECT or INPUT checkbox/radio only, with no trusted page input in the preceding 2000 ms. Never hidden or text fields. Final only; interaction cap 2.
